# Abdulrahman Ahmed Alkhairi (عبدالرحمن أحمد الخيري)

> Abdulrahman Ahmed Alkhairi (Arabic: عبدالرحمن أحمد الخيري, also written Abdalrahman Alkhairy) is a Palestinian graphic designer and digital content creator from Gaza, based in Kütahya, Türkiye. Since 2019 he has worked remotely with companies and organizations in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf on brand identity, social media design, corporate profiles and motion graphics. He publishes Arabic tech content on YouTube and Instagram as @abdalrhman_alkhairy.

## Who he is
- Role: Graphic Designer, Visual Communication Specialist and Digital Content Creator (مصمم جرافيك وصانع محتوى رقمي)
- From: Gaza, Palestine. Based in: Kütahya, Türkiye. Works remotely.
- Experience: 7+ years in design (since 2019), 200+ projects, 2,000+ design services delivered
- Since 2023: leads the remote design team at Al-Qimma Advanced Digital Services (Saudi Arabia)
- Has worked with: Ensany Global (humanitarian), Edumeter, Digiway, Siaq Agency, King Khalid University, Molan Steel, and 65+ brands
- Education: Computer Programming at Kütahya Dumlupınar University
- Languages: Arabic (native), Turkish, English

## Services
- Social media design and digital campaigns
- Brand identity and logo design
- Corporate profiles and editorial design
- Motion graphics and video editing
- Packaging and print design
- Creative direction
- Script writing, video production and publishing for content
